Currency-sensitive amounts use annual CURCD and independently verified historical security-price currency. FUNDA.HIID is the Historic Primary Global Issue ID; FUNDA.IID is the current header ID. A same-GVKEY/HIID monthly security-price quote in the fiscal month is supported by a unique known CURCDM and PRCCM agreeing with PRCC_F; a dated SEC_MTH PRIMISS=P marker corroborates the route when present, while an absent marker alone is not a contradiction. If monthly data do not verify the route, SEC_DPRC may support only the same HIID on the annual date or up to seven calendar days earlier when CRSP.DSI confirms zero intervening market sessions, one known CURCDD, and PRCCD agreement with PRCC_F. The actual matched price date supplies EXRATD. Long stale quotes, explicit marker conflicts, ambiguous currencies, and contradictory prices remain unavailable. Positive GBP currency quotes pair on the same date regardless of EXRATTPD; source-leg and target-leg provenance are retained separately. Unlike units use the provider-documented GBP cross-rate formula, with EXRATD for stocks/prices and EXRAT12M for flows, at each amount’s own source date. Same-currency ratios remain native; unsupported price currencies and unavailable/ambiguous rates remain missing.

fits.blocked_reason: Stata executed the corrected handoff (3,144 SAS rows; 3,128 after perfect-prediction deletions) but failed to converge after 300 iterations, returning r(430). SIC2 14 removed 1 row, SIC2 45 removed 11, and SIC2 75 removed 4; Stata reported 48 failures and 41 successes completely determined. No valid estimate or exports are retained.

limitations: Catalog probes confirm current-vintage source access and field presence but not full historical coverage for the analysis populations.
The 2004 provider guide verifies the legacy item crosswalk, including A123=IBC and the distinct A18=IB; current-vintage data equivalence and historical coverage remain unverified.

The paper’s Table 1 footnote describes 1st/99th percentile trimming based on DTE and accrual measures, while the printed p. 504 narrative specifies DTE percentile tails plus an absolute scaled-accrual cutoff of 1; the implementation follows the explicit narrative rule.

The analyst sample cannot apply the paper’s I/B/E/S stock-split adjustment factor >3 screen because the local EPS summary/detail records do not provide that per-observation field; event split factors are not assumed equivalent.
IBES-to-Compustat links, forecast period conventions, and the 62-day fiscal-period matching tolerance are best-effort; ambiguous company-year matches are dropped.
The paper conflicts on EM1 market-value timing: Table 1 uses t−2 while Tables 2–4 notes use t−1; this build follows the primary table notes.
Table 4 reports 2,279 target-3 observations, while the sample prose reports 2,179 for a related forward-looking analyst sample; the assigned Table 4 result-set count is retained.

The source is silent on probit covariance estimation and on the forward-looking/k minimum calibration group size; default model-based probit inference and a documented N≥10 auxiliary-fit threshold are used.

Published versus local sample counts remain larger across all nine result sets after the corrected item-123 mapping. The build checks source filters, zero Compustat GVKEY-year duplicates, adjacent-year joins, IBES link attrition, unique forecast company-years, and final counts, but these checks do not establish a single cause for the remaining size gaps.

The bounded historical-price audit found 44,362 supported HIID monthly routes and 24 supported same-HIID daily routes (15 exact-date and 9 short market-closure lags), for 44,386 verified currencies among 53,605 annual price keys; 9,219 remain unavailable. Every verified monthly route had the same price date as FUNDA.DATADATE and a same-date P marker. Production route statuses include 2 monthly price-diff and 235 daily price-diff keys; the separate raw daily mismatch indicator is 237 because it overlaps the two monthly-diff keys. Four additional `DAILY_MARKET_GAP` status labels do not require price agreement; the bounded accepted-route audit found no price-agreeing short-lag quote spanning a market session. Another 115 same-HIID daily quotes matched PRCC_F but were 8–366 days old and are not transferred. Against A4’s strict header-IID monthly verification (42,443), the corrected HIID routes recover 1,944 keys; one header-only route remains unconfirmed, and the jointly verified routes have no currency disagreements. Nine verified overlaps use different issue IDs but agree on currency. A4 also had ten legacy price flags with missing PRCC_F and missing price gaps; those source-key flags could not enter final target-1/2 samples because market value and EM classification were missing, while target 3 does not use price.
